sql.processStepEvent.getStepEvents: select pse.id, pse.process_step_id, pse.initial_company_event_status_type_id, cest.event_status_type as initial_event_status_type, pse.event_id, pse.archived, e.event_name from flow.process_step_event pse inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id left join flow.company_event_status_type cest on cest.id = pse.initial_company_event_status_type_id where pse.process_step_id = :processStepId and pse.archived is not true
sql.processStepEvent.getAvailableEventsForSt: select e.id, e.event_name, e.archived from flow.event e where e.archived is not true and not exists ( select pse.event_id from flow.process_step_event pse where pse.process_step_id = :processStepId and pse.event_id = e.id and pse.archived is not true )
sql.processStepEvent.get: select pse.id, pse.process_step_id, pse.event_id, e.event_name, pse.archived from flow.process_step_event pse inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id where pse.id = :id
sql.processStepEvent.addEventToStep: insert into flow.process_step_event(process_step_id, event_id, created_by_id) values (:processStepId, :eventId, :createdById)
sql.processStepEvent.updateStepEvent: update flow.process_step_event set initial_company_event_status_type_id = :initialCompanyEventStatusTypeId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where process_step_id = :processStepId and event_id = :eventId
sql.processStepEvent.deleteEventFromStep: update flow.process_step_event set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
